description: An unofficial fan-made animated theme inspired by the red-and-blue atmosphere of the album Red Light by Bladee of Drain Gang. No official album artwork is included.
A Firefox theme extension that replicates the background used in 'Sonic the Hedgehog' for the level 'Spring Yard Zone'
A Firefox theme extension that replicates the background used in 'Sonic CD' for the level 'Stardust Speedway Bad Future'
